text:
Predicates:
InternationalStudent(x) ::: x is an international student in the US.
VisaF1(x) ::: x has an F1 visa.
VisaJ1(x) ::: x has a J1 visa.
NeedsApplyCPT(x) ::: x needs to apply for CPT.
NeedsApplyOPT(x) ::: x needs to apply for OPT.
WantsWork(x) ::: x wants to work in the US.
Premises:
∀x (InternationalStudent(x) → (VisaF1(x) ∨ VisaJ1(x))) ::: International students in US have either an F1 visa or a J1 visa.
∀x ((InternationalStudent(x) ∧ VisaF1(x) ∧ WantsWork(x)) → (NeedsApplyCPT(x) ∨ NeedsApplyOPT(x))) ::: An international student in US with an F1 visa needs to apply for CPT or OPT if the student wants to work in the US.
InternationalStudent(mike) ::: Mike is an international student.
(WantsWork(mike) → NeedsApplyCPT(mike)) ::: Mike needs to apply for CPT if he wants to work in the US.
Conclusion:
VisaJ1(mike) ::: Mike has a J1 visa.
